summary: Adds 'archived' to communities.management_status and archives every community whose engagement has ended (terminating / terminated with a last day already past): management_status 'archived', enforcement_active and arc_active off. Today that is exactly Eaglewood (last day 2026-09-30). Selected by status and date, not by name. Nothing is deleted; no journal entry, ledger row, violation, document or correspondence changes.

preflight.name: the management_status check exists under its migration 382 name
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = k.conrelid WHERE c.relname = 'communities' AND k.conname = 'communities_management_status_check'

preflight.name: archived is not allowed yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = k.conrelid WHERE c.relname = 'communities' AND k.conname = 'communities_management_status_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid) LIKE '%archived%'

preflight.name: exactly one community has ended (terminating / terminated, last day past)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM communities WHERE management_status IN ('terminating','terminated') AND management_end_date IS NOT NULL AND management_end_date < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::date

preflight.name: and it is Eaglewood, with financials already off
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM communities WHERE name = 'Eaglewood' AND management_status IN ('terminating','terminated') AND management_end_date < (now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::date AND financials_active = false

preflight.name: status counts before (9 active, 3 prospect, 1 terminating)
preflight.sql: SELECT string_agg(management_status || '=' || n, ',' ORDER BY management_status) FROM (SELECT management_status, count(*) n FROM communities GROUP BY management_status) s

expected_changes: Eaglewood: management_status terminating -> archived; enforcement_active and arc_active -> false (financials_active already false). One row updated; no row added or removed.
No other community changes. No journal entry, journal line, homeowner ledger row, violation, ARC application, interaction or document changes.

verify.name: Eaglewood is archived with enforcement and ARC off
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM communities WHERE name = 'Eaglewood' AND management_status = 'archived' AND enforcement_active = false AND arc_active = false AND financials_active = false

verify.name: status counts after (9 active, 3 prospect, 1 archived): no other community changed
verify.sql: SELECT string_agg(management_status || '=' || n, ',' ORDER BY management_status) FROM (SELECT management_status, count(*) n FROM communities GROUP BY management_status) s

verify.name: the check allows archived
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'communities_management_status_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%archived%'
